children: SC II Acquisition reported net income in the quarter, compared with a net loss a year earlier, as $1.6M of interest earned on trust-account securities and $188 of operating-account interest more than offset $164,683 in general and administrative expenses. The company has not commenced operations or generated revenue.
: The company had not entered into a definitive agreement with a specific target as of September 30, 2026.
: Marketable securities held in the trust account totaled $177.5M at September 30, 2026, including approximately $5.0M of interest income.
: The company has until May 25, 2027, to complete a business combination, with two possible three-month extensions at the sponsor’s option.
